label: strata
doc: Ask the engine to change the world. Requires `import strata;`. Scripts queue effects; they do not own the entity list.

label: move
doc: Nudge this entity in world pixels this frame. Positive Y is down.

label: rot
doc: Add to this entity’s rotation, in degrees.

label: set
doc: Set this entity’s world position. Unlike move, this is absolute, not a delta.

label: spawn
doc: Clone a scene prefab (`"Orb"` or `{ "prefab", "x", "y" }`) or spawn a new entity from a spec map (`name`, `x`, `y`, optional `kind` / `w` / `h` / `color` / `script`).

label: destroy
doc: Remove an entity by scene name, or this entity when called with no args.

label: play_sound
doc: Play an audio clip by asset name (for example "jump.wav"). Play looks the name up in the project audio library. A missing clip logs [audio not found …] when that library is non-empty.

label: after
doc: Call `method` on this entity once after `delay` seconds. No async or await.

label: find
doc: Look up a scene entity by exact name, or with no args return the nearest other entity's name. Returns none if nothing matches. Not a query language.

label: input
doc: Keyboard state for this Play tick. Requires `import input;`. Prefer `input.pressed` / `input.held` over CSV `keys` / `pressed` hook args.

label: pressed
doc: True once when that key goes down this frame (`"Space"`, `"KeyQ"`, `"ArrowRight"`, …). Holding does not retrigger.

label: held
doc: True while that key is down this frame. Use for movement.

label: str
doc: String helpers. Requires `import str;`. Pass the string as the first argument (`str.contains(keys, "KeyA")`).

label: contains
doc: True when `s` contains `sub`. For Play input, prefer `input.held` / `input.pressed`.

label: starts_with
doc: True when `s` begins with `prefix`.

label: ends_with
doc: True when `s` ends with `suffix`.

label: repeat
doc: Repeat `s` `n` times.

label: length
doc: Character length of `s`.

label: is_empty
doc: True when `s` has length 0.

label: upper
doc: Uppercase copy of `s`.

label: lower
doc: Lowercase copy of `s`.

label: trim
doc: Strip leading and trailing whitespace.

label: split
doc: Split `s` on `sep`. An empty separator returns a one-element array with `s`.

label: slice
signature: str.slice(s: String, start: Int, end: Int): String
doc: Substring from `start` up to `end` (half-open, character indices, clamped).

label: math
doc: Numeric helpers (`abs`, `sin`, `clamp`, …). Requires `import math;`. Trig uses radians. `Vec2` is a crate class, not this module.

label: Vec2
signature: class Vec2 { var x: Float; var y: Float }
doc: Crate 2D vector. Construct with `Vec2 { x, y }`. Methods: `length()`, `add(other)`. Always in scope.

label: Vec3
signature: class Vec3 extends Vec2 { var x: Float; var y: Float; var z: Float }
doc: Crate 3D vector. Construct with `Vec3 { x, y, z }`. Methods: `length()`, `add(other)`. Always in scope.

label: node
doc: Scene node base (`Node`, `Empty`, `Sprite`, …). Import the type before `extends` (`import strata.Sprite;`). `@node class Foo extends Sprite` inherits transform + lifecycle hooks.

label: Node
signature: class Node { var name: String; var x: Float; var y: Float; var z: Float; fn on_create(self); fn on_update(self, dt: Float); … }
doc: Transform only. Parent other nodes. Same kind as Empty. Lifecycle: `on_create`, `on_update(self, dt)`, `on_destroy`, `on_enter` / `on_exit`.

label: Empty
doc: Transform only. Parent other nodes.

label: Sprite
doc: Textured quad. Draw and collide. Typical `@node` parent.

label: Tilemap
doc: Paint a grid. Solid cells are walls.

label: Camera
doc: Play follow and view frustum.

label: Mesh
doc: 3D primitive in the editor viewport.

label: Light
doc: 3D light in the editor viewport.

label: option
doc: Crate Option type (`Some` / `None`). Methods: `is_some()`, `is_none()`, `unwrap_or(fallback)`.

label: Option
doc: Present or missing value. Construct with `Some(v)` or `None`. Match on `Some(_)` / `None`.

label: result
doc: Crate Result type (`Ok` / `Err`). Methods: `is_ok()`, `is_err()`, `unwrap_or(fallback)`.

label: Result
doc: Success or failure. Construct with `Ok(v)` or `Err(e)`. Match on `Ok(_)` / `Err(_)`.

label: abs
doc: Absolute value.

label: sqrt
doc: Square root.

label: sin
doc: Sine of `n` radians.

label: cos
doc: Cosine of `n` radians.

label: atan2
doc: Two-argument arctangent, in radians.

label: min
doc: Smaller of two numbers.

label: max
doc: Larger of two numbers.

label: clamp
doc: Clamp `n` to `[lo, hi]`.

label: pow
doc: `a` raised to `b`.

label: lerp
doc: Linear interpolate from `a` to `b` by `t` (not clamped).

label: move_toward
doc: Move `current` toward `target` by at most `delta`.

label: to_int
doc: Truncate `n` toward zero.

label: to_float
doc: Convert an int to a float.

label: gcd
doc: Greatest common divisor of `a` and `b`.

label: io
doc: Read, write, append, remove text files, and list or create directories. Desktop uses the host disk. WASM Play uses an in-memory VFS (not the host disk).

label: read_text
doc: Read a UTF-8 file as Result.Ok(String). Missing or unreadable paths return Result.Err. On WASM this is the Play-session VFS, not the host disk.

label: exists
doc: True if that path exists (host disk on desktop; in-memory VFS on WASM).

label: write_text
doc: Overwrite a UTF-8 file. Creates the file if it is missing. On WASM this is the Play-session VFS, not the host disk.

label: append_text
doc: Append UTF-8 text. Creates the file if it is missing. On WASM this is the Play-session VFS, not the host disk.

label: read_lines
doc: Read a UTF-8 file as Result.Ok(Array) of lines (no trailing newlines). Missing or unreadable paths return Result.Err.

label: remove
doc: Delete a file. Returns Result.Err if the path is missing. On WASM this is the Play-session VFS, not the host disk.

label: mkdir
doc: Create a directory and any missing parents. Returns Result.Ok if it already exists. On WASM this is the Play-session VFS, not the host disk.

label: list_dir
doc: List a directory as Result.Ok(Array) of names (not full paths). Missing or non-directory paths return Result.Err.

label: is_dir
doc: True if that path is a directory (host disk on desktop; in-memory VFS on WASM).

label: time
doc: Wall-clock and VM elapsed time. Requires `import time;`. This is not frame `dt` from `on_update`.

label: now
doc: Unix time in seconds (fractional). Wall clock, not frame delta.

label: elapsed
doc: Seconds since this script VM started. Use instead of accumulating `dt`. Not wall-clock; see `time.now`.

label: ui
doc: Screen-space play HUD. Call every on_update; the list is rebuilt each frame. Requires `import ui;`.

label: text
signature: ui.text(x: Float, y: Float, text: Str)
doc: Draw text this frame in viewport pixels. Origin is the top-left of the play view, not world space.

label: checks
doc: Assertion helpers for `@test` functions.

label: that
doc: Assert `value` is true.

label: truthy
doc: Assert `value` is true.

label: falsey
doc: Assert `value` is false.

label: eq
doc: Assert `a` equals `b`.

label: neq
doc: Assert `a` is not equal to `b`.

label: eq_bool
doc: Assert two bools are equal.

label: eq_float
doc: Assert two floats are equal.

label: eq_string
doc: Assert two strings are equal.

label: on_ready
signature: fn on_ready(name: String, x: Float, y: Float): Int
doc: Called once when Play starts, after the entity is in the world. Return 0.

label: on_create
doc: On an `@node` class, called once when Play starts (engine `on_ready`). Use `self.x` / `self.y` / `self.z`.

label: on_update
signature: fn on_update(name: String, x: Float, y: Float, dt: Float): Int
doc: Called every Play frame. Extra `keys` / `pressed` CSV args may be omitted — prefer `input.held` / `input.pressed`. Return 0.

label: on_enter
signature: fn on_enter(other: String, x: Float, y: Float): Int
doc: Fired when this entity’s world AABB starts overlapping another. `other` is that entity’s name.

label: on_exit
signature: fn on_exit(other: String, x: Float, y: Float): Int
doc: Fired when this entity’s world AABB stops overlapping `other`.

label: on_destroy
doc: Called once when this entity is removed (`strata.destroy` or the host). Optional `name, x, y` parameters match `on_ready`. Return 0.

label: print
doc: Write to the Play log. Prefer `strata.*` for world changes; do not print `strata:` lines in new scripts.

label: len
doc: Length of a string, array, or map.

label: assert
doc: Runtime check. Fails the script when `cond` is false.

label: Array
doc: Build an array from arguments.

label: Map
doc: Build a map from arguments.

label: Some
doc: Option constructor for a present value. Pair with `None` and `match`.

label: None
doc: Option constructor for a missing value. Distinct from `none` (null).

label: Ok
doc: Result constructor for success. Pair with `Err` and `match`.

label: Err
doc: Result constructor for failure.
